definitions.full: H1719. Dedan or Dedaneh דְּדָן proper name, of a location & a people ; — ׳ד Gen 10:7-8 t. + Ezek 27:20 (but see below) with ה locative דְּדָ֫נֶה 25:13 compare Ges § 90 , 2 near the end; — 1 under figure of son of רַעֲמָה and grandson of כּוּשׁ (see these arts.) Gen 10:7 (brother of שְׁבָא ) = 1Chr 1:9 ; Ezek 27:20 ; compare ד ׳בְּנֵי 27:15 (but read here perhaps ᵐ5 רדן υιὁὶ Ῥοδίων , compare Sta De Pop. Javan. 11 , also ᵑ6 Co; see below דֹּדָנִים below) compare also 38:13 , וּד ׳שְׁבָא ; south-Arabian tribe on Persian Gulf, = Sabean דדן בנו according to DHM ZMG 1876, 122; Sab. Denkm. 28 (dubit. Mordt) ; but in northwest of Arabian peninsula, Glaser Skizze ii. 391 ff. ; perhaps originally further south compare Di Gen 10:7 . 2 as son of יָקְשָׁן father of אַשּׁוּרִם etc., Gen 25:3 (twice in verse) (here also brother of שְׁבָא ) = 1Chr 1:32 ; Jer 25:23 ; 49:8 ד ׳ישְׁבֵי . This is apparently a northern branch of 1 , compare Di Gen 25:3 . — On דדן in MI 31, 31 compare Sm & So MI p. 29 Nö LCB Jan. 8, 1887 ClGann JAssyrian Jan. 1887. 107 . דְּדָ֫נֶה see דְּדָןָ . רֹדָן proper name, of a location or a people Rhodes, Rhodians , so read, ר ׳בְּנֵי Ezek 27:15 (for דְּדָן בְּנֵי ᵑ0 , see ׳ד 1 ), ᵐ5 Sta Co Berthol Toy Krae.
